findings.text: Upheld as advisory: `noiseOf` and `NoisePattern` (line 10) are exported but used only inside noise.ts (rubric question 8, unused export). This does not change behaviour.
Upheld as advisory: `IMPORT_WORDING` and `IMPORT_JUDGE_VERSION` (line 40) are exported but used only in rejudge.ts (question 8).
Upheld as advisory: no current caller reaches the `perSentence` guard for wording 1 with candidates. The comment explains why it is there and it hides no failure, so it is not a question-9 defect.

Upheld as advisory: no test puts the 60% report share (src/judge/heuristic.ts:163) below 100%, so a `=== 1` mutant would survive. The discount itself is killed by probes/report-discount-removed.txt. The reviewer rated this advisory and gave the one case that would close it.
Upheld as advisory: nothing asserts the proof's 'Sentences dropped per pattern' line or `prepareTexts().dropped`. The naming is pinned only in tests/unit/noise.test.ts.

Upheld as advisory: no test has a noise sentence that appears twice in one text. `withoutSentences` replaces only the first match (src/distill/noise.ts:112). The reviewer rated it advisory and I do not raise a reviewer's severity.

Upheld as advisory, carried over from round 2: the replaying stand-in ignores the request, so a change to the version 2 wording leaves the golden floors unchanged. The version stamp is now pinned and its mutant is killed (probes/proof-metric-mutations-r3.txt).

Upheld as advisory, carried over from round 2: the proof fixture has no injections. The bound is covered through the shared `toldInSession`/`prepareTurn` by tests/integration/distill.test.ts:973-1020.
Upheld as advisory: a `'` in the work-dir path breaks the sqlite3 `.backup` dot-command. Only the operator supplies the path and no privilege boundary is crossed, so this is hardening.

Upheld as advisory: sample-*.json, full.md and verdicts.json hold copies of the author's redacted text outside the store, and forget and compact never reach them. They are owner-only (umask 077), but no step says to erase them.

Upheld as advisory: the ADR records that the samples were labelled by Claude Code subagents, the author's choice (D-4). Line 21 ('sends nothing to a model but TypeSafe') should say that the labeller also sees the samples.
Lowered to advisory as debt outside the change: the `WIZARDINGCODE_MEM_TYPESAFE_URL` endpoint override is the production judge's existing behaviour.

Upheld as advisory: the named drops are discarded in the live drain, so a loss of knowledge after the merge would not be seen. The spec states this as Known (spec line 299) and gives a rollback, so it is not a missing rollback.

Upheld as advisory: a rollback does not re-distil turns that version 2 skipped, and compact removes their text after 90 days. The spec states the rollback and the window, so no rollback is missing (no defect). Tying D-1 to the 90-day window is advised.
Upheld as advisory: an unclosed block tag outside a fence cuts the rest of the answer without a trace. The spec names this risk.
Upheld as advisory: `withoutSentences` may remove the first match rather than the segmented occurrence. The damage is limited to the judge's context, since kept candidates are sent separately.
Lowered to advisory as debt outside the change: replace-imports may archive more imports once version 2 stores fewer memories. It can be undone with restore-imports.
Lowered to advisory, as the reviewer listed it outside the change: the quoting of the `.backup` target fails loudly and only in the proof. It is the same point as security F-1.

Upheld as advisory: the doc comments for `durable`/`titleIdx` still give the version 1 meanings. The new meaning is declared in spec section 7 and ADR 0023, so this is not undeclared drift (Q2/Q3). Reword the comments.

Upheld as advisory: the rule that the title must be knowledge sits in `buildDraft` in pipeline.ts, while the spec says policy.ts. This is a design detail read differently and no boundary is crossed (Q5/Q6). Where `buildDraft` lived before the diff is debt.

Upheld as advisory (Q5): the full copy of the live store and the samples in the work dir have no stated erasure and sit outside compact's retention and history forget. This is a local dev artifact, owner-only.
Upheld as advisory (Q2): no index covers the SKIPPED_ROWS NOT EXISTS subquery. It runs offline and read-only on a copy, so it is slow but loses nothing.
Upheld as advisory (Q1): `openDb` migrates the copy, so a later binary could measure against a newer schema than the one the labels were taken on. The live store is never written.
Lowered to advisory as debt outside the change: the partial index `injections_once` cannot serve `toldInSession`. That was true before this diff.
